faqs.q: Kya WGMB API official WhatsApp API hai?
faqs.a: Haan, WGMB API bilkul official Meta-approved WhatsApp Business API solution hai. Aapka account safe rahega.

faqs.q: Kya mera purana WhatsApp number delete hoga?
faqs.a: Nahi! WGMB Coexist API se aap apna existing number use kar sakte ho bina delete kiye.

faqs.q: Ek baar mein kitne messages bhej sakte hain?
faqs.a: Aap ek baar mein 1000+ customers ko bulk WhatsApp messages bhej sakte hain high delivery reliability ke saath.

faqs.q: Setup mein kitna time lagta hai?
faqs.a: Hamaari team 24-48 ghante mein complete setup aur installation kar deti hai, saath mein training bhi deti hai.
Aapko after-sales live call support milega. Hum hamesha available hain — call ya WhatsApp pe contact kar sakte hain.
Haan! WhatsApp chatbot automation dono plans mein included hai — auto-replies, lead handling, booking automation sab.
